numerical_reproduction.tolerance_basis: The printed one-standard-error uncertainty of the Table 1 pressure checkpoint.

state_classification.method: Match each exact Table 1 pressure-volume-temperature coordinate to the plotted marker shape; no coordinate is digitized or inferred from a subjective phase-boundary trace.

source_thermal_pressure_model.units: Cv in J/(mol K), V in cm^3/mol, and thermal pressure divided by 1000 to obtain GPa.

methods.scope: LDA+U FPMD stress after the reported Pulay and empirical LDA-overbinding corrections.

recalculation.notes: No experimental pressure standard is involved.

assessment.basis: Figure 1 resolves state membership exactly: the 40 circles are the liquid states used in the source fit and the six squares are excluded. Supporting Figures S3-S4 contain only high-resolution raster plots, but their regression-line slopes are digitized at nine volumes and reproduce the paper's stated Cv and gamma ranges. The digitized Cv function is close to the published Gaussian; the gamma polynomial remains sensitive to the unavailable source weighting. Subtracting either published or digitized thermal coefficients and freely fitting four BM4 parameters is nearly singular and hits the K0-double-prime audit bound. A stabilized check with V0 and K0-double-prime fixed recovers K0=2.24587 GPa and K0'=23.0422, but the unstable four-parameter sensitivity result must not be reported as a refitted EOS. Exact reproduction still requires the unrounded source values, constraints, weighting, and covariance treatment.

fit.objective: diagnostic unweighted pressure residuals after subtracting the rounded printed Equations (4), (10)-(13) thermal pressure; this is not the paper's staged regression
fit.selection: phase_state=liquid and used_in_published_eos_fit=yes: 40 Figure 1 circles; six Figure 1 squares excluded

scientific_validation.note: Validated against the final open-access publication; LitCurate was used only as a discovery lead.

primary_source_check.finding: The article explicitly defines a 2500 K BM4 reference isotherm and reports all four coefficients. Figure 1 states that circles are the liquid states used in the EOS fit and squares are nonliquid; matching the exact Table 1 P-V-T coordinates to symbol shape gives 40 circles and six squares without digitizing coordinates. At the Table 1 V/Vx=1 state (V=40.72 cm^3/mol), the converted executable BM4 gives 1.08485 GPa versus the printed 1.07(12) GPa.

primary_data_check.finding: All 46 printed P-V-T states and pressure standard errors are transcribed. Figure 1 symbol shapes supply an exact row classification at those already-tabulated coordinates: 40 circle states are liquid and used in the source EOS fit; six square states are nonliquid and excluded. The regression-line slopes in the original high-resolution raster TIFFs for supporting Figures S3-S4 are digitized at nine volumes, yielding the plotted Cv and gamma values with explicit digitization uncertainties.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Calculated states/theory determine this EOS; source: Computational methods, Section 2; Table 1; Figure 1 and caption; Equations (4)-(9), Section 3.1.
parameter_provenance.equation: Section 3.1, Equations (4)-(9): the reference-temperature pressure P_T0(V) is a fourth-order Birch-Murnaghan EOS at T0=2500 K.
parameter_provenance.V0: Section 3.1: 47.25 cm^3/mol, converted using the exact Avogadro constant to 78.46047092 A^3 per FeSiO3 formula unit.
parameter_provenance.uncertainties: The paper gives pressure standard errors for Table 1 states but no uncertainties or covariance for the fitted EOS coefficients.
